consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1991-10-28 show was emotionally charged due to the recent passing of Bill Graham, which influenced the atmosphere and performance. While some reviewers noted flaws in the recording, many praised the overall quality of the music and the band's ability to connect with the audience during this poignant moment.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 16 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: The emotional weight of the show and the quality of certain performances were praised, but there were also criticisms regarding the recording quality and the overall atmosphere.
